table.specLine: The composer is the text box plus file-add, speak, and a visible send button, pinned to the bottom and inside the viewport. Served pages reserve 24px under the document for the build stamp (body padding-bottom: 24px).
Tab icons are vertically centered within their tab.
No element is wider than the viewport: document scrollWidth <= innerWidth, and each element's right <= innerWidth. Half a pixel is float rounding only.
On the signup page, a header that is present sits at the top of the viewport.

With 0 or 1 vacations the conversation is the top region and ends above the text box. With 2 or more and no website yet, the conversation ends above the text box. The vacation website sits on top, and the control slider sits in the middle, above the text box. Placement of the conversation under a website is not graded.
With 0 or 1 vacations the header is absent or its height is 0. An empty header bar fails. Website full-screen: the website fills the viewport.
